meta.title: Withholding Tax Automation: refused for a user without the Finance Controller role
gaps: Select or verify the Enterprise tenant and plan because no tenant identifier is provided and no catalog step checks plan access.
Sign in as a user without the Finance Controller role and attempt Withholding Tax Automation, including observing whether it is refused or absent.
Repeat the action as a Finance Controller and verify that Withholding Tax Automation is available and can determine withholding tax automatically.
Record whether RBAC deliberately grants the capability to additional roles.
